catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds a one-shot acquisition arm on an instrument. cap.measure.spectrum.v1 binds instrument.spectrometer and instrument.spectrophotometer and is a spectrum sweep; cap.world.step.v1 is a simulated-world step; cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque, not instrument. The action sends the clone's :SING (src/rigol_dho824_mcp/server.py:2715) and reports the command it sent.

No catalogue class binds an instrument's SCPI error queue. cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque, not instrument; cap.device.configure.v1 is the named-parameter write class. The action reads and removes the oldest :SYSTem:ERRor? entry (src/rigol_dho824_mcp/server.py:1349) and returns the error string.

notes:
PASS on the fake backend: python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/aimoda__rigol-dho824-mcp --backend fake exited 0 with all gates G1-G9 passing and printed the digest above; evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The upstream clone stayed read-only at 2b177ae161463c911dce3608ab37e8cadcefc4f6; no upstream code was imported or run. The fake is an in-memory stateful SCPI transport, not a recording or transcript: the clone ships no simulator and no recorded session was available, and every start value in fake.py is marked # placeholder. No fake number is used as a Fact, a Limit or a reference.

Covered: identity (*IDN?); acquisition/trigger status (read :TRIG:STAT?, write RUN/STOP via :RUN/:STOP); DVM enabled, mode and current voltage (:DVM:ENABle, :DVM:MODE, :DVM:CURRent?); channel-1 display, coupling, vertical scale, offset, probe ratio, invert and 20 MHz bandwidth limit (:CHAN1:...); main timebase scale and offset (:TIM:MAIN:...); the single-acquisition extension (:SING); the error-queue extension (:SYSTem:ERRor?); and a write-only e-stop :STOP. The bridge probes *IDN? on connect and reads :SYSTem:ERRor? after writes, as the clone's checked write does. Limits: vertical scale 0.0005 to 10 V (manuals/DHO800_DataSheet_EN.md:149), timebase 5e-09 to 500 s (line 162), probe ratios, coupling and bandwidth lists (manuals/DHO800900_ProgrammingGuide_EN.md:3886, 3686, 3664), DVM mode ACRM/DC/DCRM (src/rigol_dho824_mcp/server.py:295-297) and acquisition RUN/STOP (server.py:2679-2697). The vertical-scale limit is the 1X-probe range; another probe ratio changes the device's range, so the declared envelope only narrows. Offset is read-only because its range depends on the current vertical scale (data sheet line 150).

NOT COVERED: the waveform array. The clone captures it with :WAV:DATA? as an IEEE 488.2 WORD binary block (server.py:2220-2273) and writes JSON files; no catalogue class carries an oscilloscope trace yet, so the package serves the scope's scalar settings and status, not the samples. Also not exposed: the screenshot (:DISPlay:DATA? PNG), trigger configuration beyond the status query, channels 2-4, DVM source selection, autoset/force-trigger/reset, memory depth and acquisition type, and the FTP/WFM export. The card's hint class cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque, not instrument, and cap.measure.voltage.v1 binds instrument.dmm, instrument.smu and sensor; neither fits an oscilloscope, so the two actions use x-cap ids listed in catalogue_requests and the settings use cap.device.configure.v1.

Risk is R1: the card floor is R0, but the package exposes writable settings under cap.device.configure.v1, whose class floor is R1. No independent hardware e-stop or hardware safe-state action is claimed at R1; the e-stop is the clone's :STOP, and the scope is a measurement instrument with no driven output. Deployment: the hardware backend is the SCPI bridge, which needs host/port or a VISA resource (the clone's RIGOL_RESOURCE, such as TCPIP0::<scope>::inst0::INSTR) and, for visa_resource, pyvisa; the upstream package is not imported by this driver and was never installed. No hardware was attached, no --backend hardware or --allow-hardware was passed, and no hardware or simulator run is claimed. The package is model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run retriage-drivers-1-022) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no human reviewed or tested it. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review against the clean clone at 2b177ae161463c911dce3608ab37e8cadcefc4f6 confirmed the SCPI device-driver classification, MIT provenance and R1 risk for scalar measurement settings and acquisition requests. In driver.py and facts.md, replaced the unconditional 1X vertical-scale range with an operator-required bound, corrected class/connection, DVM, probe and waveform citations, and limited the safe-state description to the write-only :STOP path without state confirmation. Added site-limits.example.json for an explicitly preconfigured 1X deployment and test_driver.py coverage for missing bounds, overlay enforcement and a failed receipt on an instrument error. Documented fake fidelity gaps in fake.py, regenerated reference.json and REFERENCE.md, and reran check-report.json. The missing-bound regression failed before the fix; afterward the 11 focused tests, all gates G1-G9, strict collection with zero warnings and all 29 resolved citations passed, with evidence remaining contract_checked and no hardware run claimed. For the human reviewer: The scope is a measurement instrument; this package commands no driven output. Vertical-scale writes require deployment bounds valid for the configured channel and permitted probe ratios; the example overlay requires an already configured 1X, voltage-axis channel and cannot verify initial settings or prevent external changes. The SCPI safety path writes :STOP without checking the error queue or reading :TRIG:STAT?, so it confirms only the write, not observed acquisition cessation or electrical isolation of the circuit under test; a front-panel or other-client RUN is outside the MHS latch. Reset sends no RUN. Ordinary resource reads omit the upstream post-query error check. Probe-dependent scale/offset changes, state-dependent rejection, acquisition timing and DVM measurement behavior are absent from the fake. RESULT.json, task.json and driver.lock.json were left byte-identical to the preserved originals; no human signature was written. No registry override or licence decision is proposed.
